name: Getty Center
address: 1200 Getty Center Dr, Los Angeles, CA 90049
tagline: Richard Meier's hilltop campus. European paintings, plus the views.
description: J. Paul Getty's 110-acre hilltop museum, designed by Richard Meier and reached by a tram from the parking lot. Strong European paintings (Van Gogh's Irises, Cézanne, Rembrandt), but the campus and gardens compete with the collection for attention.
review_long:
The Getty Center is two things at once: a serious museum of pre-20th-century European art (Van Gogh's Irises, Rembrandt, Cézanne, Manet, illuminated manuscripts) and Richard Meier's most extensive American work, a 110-acre hilltop in travertine and aluminum. The tram from the parking lot to the museum is part of the architectural sequence.

Free admission (parking is the only paid element), open until late on Saturdays, with arguably the best museum café terrace in the country.

tips.text: Admission is free, but parking is $25 (cheaper after 3 PM).
The Central Garden by Robert Irwin changes seasonally — worth its own loop.

highlights.item: Rembrandt's Old Man in Military Costume
